'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Dibaya Lubwe landslide]]
**At least 15 people are killed and 60 more are missing during a [[landslide]] in [[Idiofa]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-landslide-people-killed-dd2caaa5574ff01ccab90da57b1eb97c (AP)]
*Heavy [[flood]]s in [[Afghanistan]] have killed at least 33 people and injured 27 others in three days. About 600 houses were either damaged or destroyed, and around 200 [[livestock]] died. The floods also damaged around 800 [[hectare]]s of [[agricultural land]], and more than 85 kilometers (53 miles) of [[road]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-flooding-d9b51c3eca73292cb01fa61bf01b3f50 (AP)]
